regions.today: Mist and fog will clear later this morning.Today will be mostly cloudy and dry and any showers that develop will be isolated. Highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees with light southerly or variable winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be largely cloudy with mist and fog developing. Isolated drizzle is possible, but most places will stay dry. Mild and humid with temperatures not falling below 13 to 16 degrees, in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will start dry with some sunny spells, but it will become cloudy and spells of showery rain will move northeastwards across the region through the day. The rain will be heavy at times. Warm and humid with highest temperatures of 18 to 23 degrees, with light to moderate southerly winds at first, increasing moderate to fresh through the day.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate or Low on Sunday and Monday.
